recipes.why: Sound events are tied to visible actions, and the label text is quoted and short.

steps.label: Hero
steps.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a macro close-up of {product} reading "{label}" standing on {surface}, soft top light, shallow depth of field. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as one drop gathers at the tip, swells and falls. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up as a hand lifts the bottle out of frame, leaving a ring of water behind; the camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed to a blurred window of morning light.

overall_soundscape: Low room tone under the tick of glass on stone, the soft plop of a single drop into a small pool, a quiet ripple.

non_diegetic_music: Minimal solo piano, three sparse notes at a slow tempo over a soft synth pad, fading at the end.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, macro nature time-lapse, one continuous shot, no cuts, {seed}. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the seed splits, a pale root pushes down into the soil, and a curled green shoot rises and unfolds its first two leaves.
